name: @light/workspace
description: A folder as a native app works in it: its files (git's view or a capped walk), its git state read without touching the index (status, branches, the log, a commit's files, a file at HEAD), what changed against a base, a tree of the files, a watcher batching the folder's changes, a file's lines read from an offset, and a controller holding the folder's snapshots for the views.
